scope: Repeated Wi-Fi connection/DHCP diagnostics on Linux; no deepsleep transitions in these attempts.
privacy: Allowlisted derived evidence only. No raw packets, network/device identities, addresses, SSIDs, hostnames, credentials or application paths.

captures.note: Connection result exists; quick output is not a usable saved packet capture.

parser_tests.scope: Saved private packet reconstruction/parser checks; not a fresh hardware test.

limitations: Router-side capture does not itself prove Wi-Fi delivery to the board.
No saved target frames means none observed at this capture point, not proof that no radio frame was transmitted.
Private parser requires non-empty input; genuinely empty frozen snapshots are counted without invoking it.
RAM observations are external telemetry; packet XID matching correlates the observations.
RAM signed XID is preserved as xid and additionally normalized to xid_u32 using & 0xffffffff.
Failed helper/host preconditions are not counted as failed DHCP connection results.
A BADAUTH join-state sample does not by itself prove wrong credentials.
PM order is sequential, not randomized; these samples cannot establish a universal PM fix.
Power consumption and cycle energy were not measured.
